$comment: Top-level fields: the walking skeleton's first numbers (M1 app-1), printed by tests/e2e/bot-race.spec.ts on the dev machine with no throttling; informational only. `soft` is the perf check's soft-tier baseline (tests/perf/perf.spec.ts fails above 2x it), measured on a CI runner as docs/engineering.md asks. Update it in a PR whose changes note gives the reason.
source: dev machine, headless Chromium from @playwright/test 1.63.0, viewport 915x412 CSS px, device pixel ratio 1, no CPU throttling
scene: bot-race: the skeleton track (3 edges, 2.5 km), 2 box riders, no traffic; checkpoints at tick 60, halfway along the route, and the results screen

soft.source: GitHub Actions ubuntu runners, the perf run in CI's last browser slice, on current main code: the 8 CI runs listed below (main 3309a1f, the six rounds of bundle PR 355, main b86069b); headless Chromium shell from @playwright/test 1.63.0, SwiftShader, viewport 915x412 @1, 4x CPU throttling from the race start, 20 s of the seed-1 bot race

rebaselined.reason: The perf scene has grown since 2026-09-30: real rider and bike models (PR 300, PR 346), blob shadows, roadside weapons, the off-road ground band (PR 343), rivals from the region's cast with seeded light (PR 323) and the cop roadblock (PR 338). Triangles at the tick-840 checkpoint went from about 68,000 to about 116,000 on 2026-10-02 alone. These 8 runs on current main code printed frame p95 of 83.4, 100.1, 116.6, 133.3, 133.3, 149.9, 150 and 150 ms (5 to 9 frames), frame p50 of 50 to 66.7 ms and sim step p95 of 4.7 to 6.8 ms; 3 of the 8 failed the old 141.5 ms p95 limit, one of them on main. The medians, rounded to whole frames, are p50 66.7 ms (4 frames), p95 133.3 ms (8 frames) and step p95 4.9 ms, so the limits are 141.7 ms, 274.9 ms and 9.8 ms. The phone number comes from the maintainer's playtest, not from this tier.

softInk.source: GitHub Actions ubuntu runners, the perf run's three ink looks (kodak, wasteland, brush; tests/perf/perf-looks.spec.ts) in the same 8 CI runs as `soft`, same scene and throttling
softInk.previous: p50 50 and p95 116.7 ms (seven kodak runs on 2026-10-01, PR 177)
softInk.reason: The ink looks draw the scene offscreen and add a full-screen pass, which SwiftShader pays for in CPU time, and the scene grew as `soft` says. In the same 8 runs the three ink looks (24 results) printed frame p95 of 133.3 to 216.7 ms (median 183.4) and frame p50 of 66.6 to 99.9 ms (median 83.4). None failed yet, but 5 of the 24 printed a p50 of 99.9 ms against the old 108.3 ms limit, one frame from failing. The medians, rounded to whole frames, are p50 83.3 ms (5 frames) and p95 183.3 ms (11 frames), so the limits are 174.9 ms and 374.9 ms.
